name: mcp-ai-wpoos
description: NV Digital Open Operator System (oOS) - WordPress plugin integrating MCP tools with AI workflows

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js && npm run build:js:pro && npm run build:workflow
scripts.minify:css: cleancss -o assets/css/admin-settings.min.css assets/css/admin-settings.css && cleancss -o assets/css/chat.min.css assets/css/chat.css && cleancss -o assets/css/settings-dashboard.min.css assets/css/settings-dashboard.css && cleancss -o assets/css/user-chats.min.css assets/css/user-chats.css && cleancss -o assets/css/mcp-diagnostic.min.css assets/css/mcp-diagnostic.css && cleancss -o assets/css/tools-manager.min.css assets/css/tools-manager.css
scripts.minify:js:legacy: uglifyjs assets/js/admin-settings.js -o assets/js/admin-settings.min.js -c -m && uglifyjs assets/js/chat.js -o assets/js/chat.min.js -c -m && uglifyjs assets/js/settings-dashboard.js -o assets/js/settings-dashboard.min.js -c -m && uglifyjs assets/js/user-chats.js -o assets/js/user-chats.min.js -c -m && uglifyjs assets/js/auth0-setup.js -o assets/js/auth0-setup.min.js -c -m && uglifyjs assets/js/mcp-diagnostic.js -o assets/js/mcp-diagnostic.min.js -c -m && uglifyjs assets/js/performance-blocks.js -o assets/js/performance-blocks.min.js -c -m
scripts.postinstall: (cd addons/pro && npm install --legacy-peer-deps --omit=optional) || echo 'Pro addon install failed, continuing...' && npm run install:chartjs && npm run install:vectorizer && npm run install:vectorizer:fix && npm run build:js:pro || true
scripts.install:vectorizer: rm -rf assets/js/vendor/neplex-vectorizer && mkdir -p assets/js/vendor/neplex-vectorizer && cp -r node_modules/@neplex/vectorizer* assets/js/vendor/neplex-vectorizer/

author: NV Digital Solutions
